verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents broad programmatic coverage: a CKS API for cluster create, list, update and delete, a Terraform provider spanning clusters, VPCs, object storage and inference, an Inference API with generated clients, and a FOCUS billing export API in Public Preview. However, the docs place some workflows only in the Cloud Console, such as Capacity Finder and viewing or requesting quotas, and they make no claim of full API/UI parity. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path. missing for 10: an explicit API-parity commitment, API access to Capacity Finder and quota management, a published OpenAPI spec, GA (not preview) billing API, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The API lets you create, list, update, and delete managed Kubernetes clusters on CoreWeave infrastructure.
The CoreWeave Terraform provider lets you manage CoreWeave infrastructure as code, including CKS clusters, VPC networking, AI Object Storage policies and buckets, and Managed Inference resources.
The CoreWeave Inference API provides programmatic control over inference gateways, model deployments, and capacity claims.
You can also export usage programmatically with the FOCUS API (Public Preview)
